changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.comment: Two clinical departments to hang the seeded wards off
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO department (id, name, code, active) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), v.name, v.code, true FROM (VALUES ('Internal Medicine', 'INTMED'), ('Obstetrics and Gynaecology', 'OBGYN') ) AS v(name, code) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM department existing WHERE existing.name = v.name);

changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.comment: One bed type per category of bed, with a real nightly rate
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO bed_type (id, name, default_daily_rate, active) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), v.name, v.rate, true FROM (VALUES ('GENERAL', 3500.00), ('MATERNITY', 5000.00), ('HDU', 8000.00), ('ICU', 15000.00) ) AS v(name, rate) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM bed_type existing WHERE existing.name = v.name);

changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO ward (id, name, location, active, department_id) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), v.name, v.location, true, d.id FROM (VALUES ('General Ward A', 'Block B, 1st floor', 'Internal Medicine'), ('Maternity Ward', 'Block C, 1st floor', 'Obstetrics and Gynaecology') ) AS v(name, location, department_name) JOIN department d ON d.name = v.department_name WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ward existing WHERE existing.name = v.name);

changeSet.author: hms
changeSet.comment: Six beds across those wards, all available and none price-overridden
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO bed (id, bed_number, daily_rate_override, status, ward_id, bed_type_id, version) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), v.bed_number, NULL, 'AVAILABLE', w.id, t.id, 0 FROM (VALUES ('General Ward A', 'GENERAL', 'A-01'), ('General Ward A', 'GENERAL', 'A-02'), ('General Ward A', 'GENERAL', 'A-03'), ('General Ward A', 'HDU', 'A-04'), ('Maternity Ward', 'MATERNITY', 'M-01'), ('Maternity Ward', 'MATERNITY', 'M-02') ) AS v(ward_name, bed_type_name, bed_number) JOIN ward w ON w.name = v.ward_name JOIN bed_type t ON t.name = v.bed_type_name WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM bed existing WHERE existing.ward_id = w.id AND existing.bed_number = v.bed_number );
